company_info.company_description: ".. we have come a long way from our humble beginnings in a small office in Narre Warren, Melbourne. We maintain our absolute commitment to customer relationships, satisfaction, integrity and transparency."

reviews.review_description: Recently had a battery added to a roughly 5 year old PV system.I could not fault the customer service - John Vo from Suncurrent answered all my questions promptly, and I had a LOT of questions.We were able to retain and re-use the 7.9 kW of panels; it turned out to be cheaper and simpler to replace the existing inverter.We went with Fox ESS 6.0 kW inverter and 18.6kWh  (16.7 kWh useable) Fox batteries.The installer turned up when he said he would, and his team worked really hard to run the cables, and to make the install neat.There was no sun by the time the installation was completed (Melbourne, winter); installer monitored the system and identified an issue with the CT.  Came back the next day (weekend) to fix it.It's been on-line for a week now, and the battery is (as hoped) well and truly covering our daily usage - and we have had some very cloudy days.The price I'm quoting includes upgrading distribution board, and patching / painting some unavoidable openings in walls to run cables.

They arrived on time and when they said they would.Neat and efficient. Agreed with my choices and had no trouble supplying (Sungrow Inverter/Battery and Aiko panels)Finished everything off with no mess or broken Terra Cotta tiles( amazing)Extra switchboard work was quoted for and all signed off and operational within a week.Very satisfied and would not hesitate to recommend, in fact I have already.

Great pricing and an almost identical system to the ones being quoted by the other three companies I sought quotes from.  Sun Current were very pleasant to deal with and very accommodating in terms of install date as I delayed Sun Current for 3 weeks whilst I had my Cement Tile Roof fully restored.

Sales/quoting process was very good. All enquiries were answered promptly. They sent out installers to inspect the site and recommend best positioning for the panels. The old system was removed for a reasonable price.The installation went well, they were tidy, polite and punctual.Customer service was excellent and they organised the grid connection.I have since encountered a problem with Solar Victoria. After my application to receive the solar pv rebate and after installation of the system, Solar Victoria have cancelled my application because my old system was installed after 1 November 2009. And now have to repay the rebates. I am seeking advice on this matter.

Quote itemised and transparent (you know price of parts and labour).  About just over 2 weeks to install.  One week was taken up by getting Vic solar rebate.The installation was good.  They turned up early on Monday morning.  Did what they needed to do.  Explained what is going to happen next and the documents handed over at the end.  Although final inspection and commissioning quoted as up to 2 week it was completed end of the week.Specifications: 6.6kw system (440w Jinko panels, pure black) with 5kw Growatt inverter.  East - West (limited north facing in my property) on single story.  Concrete tile roof.

Simran was my first  point of contact with this company who proved to be very professional and communicated clearly and kept me updated on how the process was developing. Phone calls and emails were followed up promptly and it was nice to hear a pleasant voice. Thank you Simran. I am very impressed also with the prompt installation all done by local electricians. I am very happy with overall performance of this company and recommend it highly.

Sun Current is my go-to Solar company.  It was a pleasure to interact with Marg and Sim in the office, and Matt did a fabulous job installing the Solar panels neatly and efficiently. Great quality installation with quality panels/inverter as recognised on this site.Communications were a bit slow - but i assume these guys are overwhelmed with demandBe aware that quotes are done 'sight unseen' - so if there is an issue installing panels you still have to pay the original quote - less a tiny discount for the panels they dont use.

However, the way Rahul has guided us through your start to end in the process buying solar. Non pushy sales approach, very patient, highly informative and helpful. A big assert for SunCurrent.

I had a contract with the Solar Supplier through the "MASH Bulk Buy" program promoted by Hepburn and other councils. I thought this is great a reputable company is being recommended and Bulk Buy means its cheaper. Right? Wrong. The same 6.6 kw system was at least $1000 cheaper through Sun Current with the SAME high grade top tier panels and inverter. The only issue is that installers were not told that a 30 metre cable had to be laid underground. This is a common communication gap between sales people and installers so CHECK every detail on your agreement.

We had the solar system installed in June.  It took Origin Energy 2 months to install a smart meter after the installation.  The solar system was turned on by the Origin Energy contractor and has not worked.  We have contacted Sun Current on several occasions during August, including our salesman, and to no avail.  They keep making excuses that they canâ€™t get in touch with the installer.  We were given the installerâ€™s phone number and heard a message saying they were unavailable for contact until October.  We have requested Sun Current to come and check our system, but they have not made any effort.  We are still waiting.  The system was supposed to be of high quality and the best on the market, so far it just doesnâ€™t work and no-one wishes to help us.  Prior to purchasing the system I checked the comments on Sun Current and had the salesman address the issues I had found and he assured me that all the issues were fixed up, however we have found that is not the case.  BE AWARE OF SUN CURRENT.

We made a great decision to choose SunCurrent. They provided us the best quality Enphase Micro-Inverter system at a better price than the other solar companies. We are very impressed with their customer service and keeping us informed at every step.We have got confirmation from our electricity company within a month that our system is connected to grid now.We are happy to recommend them to all of you as they delivered what they promised.

Great experience dealing with SunCurrent team. Very professional throughout the process. They offered me premium system at the best price. They were quick to install and then get it inspected. I will highly recommend them for anyone who wants hassle free quality solar system installation at the best price.

Initially went with Sun Current because they were willing to install a system over 6kW, other companies were more interested in installing only 4.5kW.With the system installed for almost one year, I found that the inverter was showing an alarm, further checking showed that the circuit breaker had tripped. When the circuit breaker was reset, the inverter went through the initiallising process and made snapping and cracking sounds before the circuit breaker tripper off again. My first call to Sun Current, I gave 3 different fault codes, and was told that the problem was with the grid voltage being too high. I was told to call SPAusnet to get them to lower the voltage to the meter.I played the game and had two fellows from SPAusnet come out to check the meter and transformer across the road, all was found to be within tolerance. I flicked on the circuit breaker for the inverter to demonstrate to them the problem, and they told me not to turn the breaker on again, and to get the inverter replaced straight away.Another call to Sun Currents answering service, and I was told they would send one of their technicians to inspect the inverter after the Christmas/New Year break.After the break, I emailed and was told that they had lodged a warranty claim and would advise when the new inverter arrives and when one of their technicians would come to install it.A week later I called again and was told that somebody from the inverter manufacturer would be coming out to inspect the unit.By this time I was wondering whether they were warranty dodging or folding the business all together.I ended up calling the inverter manufacturer technician who told me he had only heard about my inverter problem a week before (this is after over a month without solar) he said he would be out on Monday, and true to his word he came out, found the inverter to be faulty and replaced it straight away.Have now missed over a month of the best solar of the year, daily kWh was 40 either side of the inverter going down.Customer service from the 1300 answering service is absent, and it appears their website is as well.The salesman has been great, he answers his phone and is probably holding the company together.

The initial experience with sales team and installers was good. Installer told us we were connected to grid that day (2 nd October) as we had a smart meter already. System was generating, but two months later our supplier bill showed no solar rebates. On contact they had no knowledge of our panels. On contacting Suncurrent they said they were waiting on a new meter to arrive and would install. Now mid January. After numerous calls to Suncurrent and getting to know their answering system intimately, I have today been told they will get back to me with meter installation date. This has been a totally upsetting experience and I would advise others to seriously consider wether they want to put themselves through this.To The manager of Suncurrent, if you are reading this, start treating your customers with respect. Learn to keep in contact with them, it costs nothing and only generates good customer relationships. If you have problems with supply pass the info on, most will understand.

No upselling, no heavy sales techniques, no smooth talking â€œsign up nowâ€ deals. The system we installed consisted of 2x 2 kw systems as we are on 2 phase power, which are consistently generating 2.2kw per system. In 2 days we generated 40kw. This is because Micheal advised us on the best package and that is what we got. If you are spending the money, do yourself a favour and donâ€™t just go for the cheapest system. Customer service and installation is outstanding. Great Job. Property address is in Heathcote.

After much review and consideration, we opted for Sun Current over a number of competitors. Though in the past we used another supplier, we were rewarded with the decision to use Sun Current.The sales process was seamless and communication around install timing was a delight.Both the install and sales team checked in on us post the install to explain and demonstrate the monitoring system.Big thanks to Ben and the Victorian team - whom we would have no hesitation in recommending.

The Sun Current salesman told a few lies about the system specifications , very unhappy about that . The 5 kW SunGrow inverter derates sometimes  and I'm not happy. Reading the inverter data sheet. the inverter derates when it reaches around 55 degrees in ternal temp. . Placing a hand on the inverter during full sun you can feel the heat , the inverter  needs a better heat sinking / cooling design .  I'm getting 20kW hrs a day now , mid October in Gippsland .
